svg.data-weight-note: 24.5 lb (11.11 kg) with power supplies and fans installed (guide Table 31)
svg.data-throughput: up to 12.8 Tbps unidirectional and 25.6 Tbps bidirectional (datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-breakout-ports: 64 x 200 GbE + 2 x 10 GbE, or 128 x 100/50/25/10 GbE + 2 x 10 GbE, or 32 x 40 GbE + 2 x 10 GbE (datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-qsfpdd-speeds: 400 GbE default; 200, 100, 50, 40, 25 or 10 GbE with the matching optic or breakout cable (guide, Setting Port Speed and Channelization)
svg.data-power-measurement-note: Maximum at 40 C ambient with SR optics at 100 percent load with IMIX traffic; typical at 25 C with DACs at 50 percent load with IMIX traffic, excluding transceivers (datasheet Table 4)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 12 A at 100 to 127 VAC, 8 A at 200 to 240 VAC (guide Table 19)
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating -40 to -72 VDC, 35 A maximum (guide Table 26)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1, each able to carry the whole switch; both should be installed, on feeds A and B
svg.data-fans: six fan modules, 5+1; the switch runs three minutes without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-airflow-note: AFO is front-to-back (port-to-FRU); AFI is back-to-front (FRU-to-port); no mixing of fans and supplies of different direction
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) for AFO; 0 to 30 C for AFI (guide Table 30, datasheet Table 3)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing, operating and non-operating
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1829 m (6000 ft) at 0 to 40 C for AFO and 0 to 30 C for AFI (guide Table 30; the datasheet's AFI row reads sea level at 30 C)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Xeon D-1500 (guide); Intel Broadwell DE (datasheet)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400 GbE QSFP-DD optics and DAC, 400 GbE AOC; QSFP28 100 GbE and QSFP+ 40 GbE with breakout (guide, Network Ports for QFX5130-32CD)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: ports 32 and 33 take 10 GbE modules only, not 1 GbE
svg.data-ptp: IEEE 1588 PTP transparent and boundary clock with hardware timestamping (datasheet)
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port with link and status lamps
svg.data-emc: 47 CFR Part 15 (FCC) Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55022/EN 55032 Class A; CISPR 22/CISPR 32 Class A; EN 55024; CISPR 24; EN 300 386; VCCI Class A; AS/NZS CISPR 32 Class A; KN32/KN35; BSMI CNS 13438 Class A; EN 61000-3-2; EN 61000-3-3 (datasheet Table 5)
svg.data-nebs: designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements of NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3 (guide Table 30)
